Messages.Author: Neil
Messages.Body:
Okay, this happened in a horrible game at the GLQ, in which several rules
were forgotten about or messed up (FBI Special Affairs, Tension from the
Ranks, Sensory Dep), several turns had to be retaken, David Wilson had to be
called over repeatedly, someone was ousted when he shouldn't have been, and
a miscommunication ended up in me seeming like a dealbreaker. (I was a dirty
schemer, not a dealbreaker!)

If this too was a rule that we messed up, then the game was even more effed
up than we thought and I demand a rematch! ;)

I had Uchenna with one blood and a No Secrets from the Magaji. Erichtho does
an action and Uchenna attempts to block. Erichto plays Crocodile's Tongue at
superior, which cancels the block since Uchenna cannot pay two blood. Does
the No Secrets from the Magaji burn? David said yes, which makes some sense,
but I could see the flipside argued too. Since Croc Tongue "cancels" the
block, doesn't that mean the block effectively never happens?

Relevant text:

No Secrets: "Put this card on this magaji and untap him or her. The magaji
with this card gets +1 intercept when attempting to block vampires. If this
magaji is tapped, he or she may attempt to block a vampire as if untapped.
Burn this card if this magaji attempts to block a vampire but is not
successful. A vampire may have only one No Secrets From the Magaji."

Crocodile's Tongue: "aus Only usable when an ally or younger vampire
attempts to block. That block is canceled (the minion is not tapped). The
blocking minion's controller cannot attempt to block this action again. The
blocking minion can cancel this card by burning a blood or life. AUS As
above, but canceling this card requires an additional blood or life."

Thanks!

Neil

Messages.Author: Hardy Range
Messages.Body:
Neil wrote:
>
> I had Uchenna with one blood and a No Secrets from the Magaji. Erichtho does
> an action and Uchenna attempts to block. Erichto plays Crocodile's Tongue at
> superior, which cancels the block since Uchenna cannot pay two blood. Does
> the No Secrets from the Magaji burn? David said yes, which makes some sense,
> but I could see the flipside argued too. Since Croc Tongue "cancels" the
> block, doesn't that mean the block effectively never happens?
>
> Relevant text:
>
> No Secrets: "Put this card on this magaji and untap him or her. The magaji
> with this card gets +1 intercept when attempting to block vampires. If this
> magaji is tapped, he or she may attempt to block a vampire as if untapped.
> Burn this card if this magaji attempts to block a vampire but is not
> successful. A vampire may have only one No Secrets From the Magaji."
>
> Crocodile's Tongue: "aus Only usable when an ally or younger vampire
> attempts to block. That block is canceled (the minion is not tapped). The
> blocking minion's controller cannot attempt to block this action again. The
> blocking minion can cancel this card by burning a blood or life. AUS As
> above, but canceling this card requires an additional blood or life."

The answer is within the card texts:

Uchenna _attempted_ to block - which allowed Crocodile's Tongue to be
played in the first place (card text).
Crocodile's Tongue then goes on and cancels the block, but this does
not matter now - the attempt was made, and that is all the card text on
No Secrets from the Magaji is looking for.
The No Secrets is burned.

Greetings,
